definition: The company's statements were audited by the other company, an audit firm, for one engagement. Source: Audit: the XBRL cover page; the audit report.
label: Audited by

definition: The owner beneficially owns the issuer's securities, as a ten percent owner (Forms 3/4/5, Section 16) or a five percent owner (Schedules 13D/13G, Section 13(d)), with the percent as filed. Who owns, not who decides: an adviser's discretion is on INVESTMENT_ADVISER_TO. Source: Ownership: Exhibit 21; Schedules 13D/13G and Forms 3/4/5.
label: Beneficial owner of

definition: The custodian holds 10% or more of the adviser's separately managed account assets, as the adviser's Form ADV names it (Schedule D 5.K(3)); a custodian under 10% is not named. Source: Custody: Form ADV Schedule D 5.K(3).
label: Custodian

definition: The person works for the company as a director, an officer (with the title) or an employee. Source: People: Forms 3/4/5 role flags.
label: Employed by

definition: The trading venue's business is managed and operated by this entity, its market operator. Source: Trading venues: ISO 10383; MiFID II's market operator.
label: Has market operator

definition: The adviser is the fund's investment adviser, with discretion: discretionary (the adviser decides) or non-discretionary (the client decides). Source: Funds: Form ADV and N-CEN; GLEIF's relationship file names.
label: Investment adviser to

definition: The security is issued by this entity. Source: Securities: a Security and its issuer. A holding is not a relationship MDM masters; it lands in silver with the MDM ids of its holder and its Security.
label: Issued by

definition: The entity's accounts are consolidated, under accounting standards (IFRS 10 / ASC 810), by this direct parent; one per scope and time. Basis stated (a source says it). Source: Consolidation: GLEIF's relationship file names; IFRS 10 / ASC 810.
label: Is directly consolidated by

definition: The fund feeds its money into the other fund (a master fund). Source: Funds: Form ADV and N-CEN; GLEIF's relationship file names.
label: Is feeder to

definition: The fund is managed by this fund management entity (its fund manager). Source: Funds: Form ADV and N-CEN; GLEIF's relationship file names.
label: Is fund-managed by

definition: The branch belongs to this head office. Source: Branches: GLEIF.
label: Is international branch of

definition: The trading venue is a market segment of the other venue, its exchange. Source: Trading venues: ISO 10383; MiFID II's market operator.
label: Is segment of exchange

definition: The fund is a sub-fund of the other fund (an umbrella). Source: Funds: Form ADV and N-CEN; GLEIF's relationship file names.
label: Is subfund of

definition: The entity is listed as a subsidiary of the registrant. Source: Ownership: Exhibit 21; Schedules 13D/13G and Forms 3/4/5.
label: Is subsidiary of

definition: The top of the entity's consolidation chain: the entity that consolidates it and that no other entity consolidates. Basis stated (a source says it) or calculated (MDM walked the direct parents, with the path); the two sit side by side, so a disagreement shows. Source: Consolidation: GLEIF's relationship file names; IFRS 10 / ASC 810.
label: Is ultimately consolidated by

definition: The entity that took over this one when it ceased in a corporate action (a merger, an absorption, a demerger), with the event type and its effective date. Source: Corporate actions: GLEIF's SuccessorEntity.
label: Successor entity
